professor_reviews.author: Lia Liu
professor_reviews.body: Really good prof. Does alot of ex prblms nd will do hw prob if you ask even on the day its due. Study guides are directly related to tests. One question was even on the test itself. Allows one sheet of notes for second test and 2shts 4 final. I had a high C 1wk b4 final but I got a 100% on the final and ended up with an A. keep up w/ hw&quizzes

professor_reviews.author: Irene Tsapara
professor_reviews.body: Way too much for a basic stat course. She makes you write papers and do projects involving graphs. Does give pop quizes as well. Take Lia Liu, the other stat professor. She's much better and offers you a cheat sheet (write anything on it, even the practice exam) on the exams.

professor_reviews.author: Irene Tsapara
professor_reviews.body: I LOVED this class. People who didn't like her either didn't do the assigned work or tried to cheat their way through the class. She WANTS you to learn, and if you genuinely try to understand the material, complete all assigned work, take notes, and ask questions you WILL do well. She wants her students to succeed. Just put in work from the START.

professor_reviews.author: Dale Embers
professor_reviews.body: He's a good professor. The class and material are boring, but he's easy-going and considerate. He actually cares about the material too and teaches excitedly every day. The quizzes are based off homework so just make sure you know when they are, they're easy to study for.

professor_reviews.author: Jing Wang
professor_reviews.body: I really enjoyed Professor Wang's style of teaching. Exams were long, but she graded it fairly. She also shows you some R code that is quite useful, and she is very knowledgeable about statistics. Recommend everyone to take her (p.s. meet her during office hours, very friendly!).

professor_reviews.author: Yichao Wu
professor_reviews.body: Very hard to understand him since his accent is very heavy and speaks way too fast. He generally just flies through the notes during class and doesn't teach the concepts very well or at all. I really don't recommend him at all.

professor_reviews.body: Reckinger makes this class way harder than it needs to be. All he does is copy examples of equations from the book and does not explain it very well. Unfortunately he seems to think this is the only class as IEs we have to take.

professor_reviews.author: David He
professor_reviews.body: Test questions are easy and lifted directly from the homework, but if the number you circle isn't exactly right you automatically lose half credit, regardless of whether your error was arithmetic or conceptual. Your grade will be based more on your ability to regurgitate procedures than on your understanding of the material.

professor_reviews.author: James Kosmach
professor_reviews.body: Professor Kosmach's lectures can be very dry. He writes down everything straight out of the book. You will most likely learn very little from attending his lectures, you will most likely end up teaching yourself. Exams are usually very long and hard to finish. They need to bring back the old professor who taught this class.

professor_reviews.author: Ning Jin
professor_reviews.body: He's pretty laid back when it comes to grading. People liked him because quizzes, midterm, and even final looks just like the homework so he's really easy. There's a group quiz every week, our group had ten of us, only three problems for the whole period. However, you can hardly learn from him, I recommend do the hw to learn and not depend on him.

professor_reviews.author: Miiri Kotche
professor_reviews.body: This class was overall ok. She just read the powerpoints she made like 20 minutes before class. Really boring but you have to take it. Three proposals and 5 quizzes in the class. Make sure to study for the quizzes if you want to get an A.

professor_reviews.body: Classes started off rough but he was willing to help out. He's really funny and that really helps uplift a class before an exam. He even makes sure to give students 1 on 1 time during office hours for help. Don't sleep on him.

professor_reviews.body: The work load for this class is higher than other CALC 2 classes because he likes to make students memorize things he will never test them on and he will introduce topics not on the syllabus. He doesn't follow the book and which would be great if we could understand him. If he is having a bad day you notice it easily. Will never take him again.

professor_reviews.author: Vi Diep
professor_reviews.body: average teacher. wasnt amazing, but wasnt horrible. if you want an A you have to do a fair amount of self study. she can be confusing sometimes and i had to seek outside help. wouldnt recommend if you have other options. crowdmark can be annoying and she doesnt accept late work.

professor_reviews.author: Evangelos Kobotis
professor_reviews.body: He's definitely passionate about his subject. I loved him in Calc 1, and couldn't get into his class for Calc 2 but I got in for Calc 3. Bad idea. He goes way too fast to understand anything, and barely does examples on the board. He's too obsessed with chewing gum and texting, which has stopped the lecture mid-sentence before. Be careful. No book!

professor_reviews.author: Kevin Whyte
professor_reviews.body: I would recommend that you do NOT take this professor, he knows his stuff and he will help.  But learning from him is difficult because when he speaks, he whispers.  He knows about his problem too but he doesn't seem to do anything about it.  If your taking him, read the book and learn from it, it will be your teacher for this semester.
